setup.title: Configure device
setup.intro: Show a setup QR so the device form is filled in for you and you only type your WiFi.
setup.step1: Power on the device and join the WiFi network named SecurIoT-Setup-XXXX from your phone. The last four characters are different for each device.
setup.step2: Press Show setup QR on this page.
setup.step3: Scan the QR code with your phone camera and open the link.
setup.step4: Type the name and password of your WiFi network when the setup page asks for them.
setup.step5: Check the filled-in fields and press Save and connect. The device restarts by itself.
setup.warningBody: It contains the secret key of the device. Do not share it, post it or take a screenshot of it, and open the link only while your phone is connected to the SecurIoT-Setup network.
setup.qrAlt: QR code with the setup link for this device. The same link is written as text below the code.
setup.qrCaption: Scan it with the phone that is connected to the SecurIoT-Setup network. It hides itself after about 2 minutes.
setup.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select the text in the field and copy it by hand.
setup.hiddenMessage: QR code hidden. Press Show setup QR to display it again.
setup.expiredMessage: The QR code was hidden to protect the device key. Press Show setup QR to display it again.
setup.needsEdgeUrl: Save the device's Edge API URL (in Face recognition) before configuring it.
setup.errorNotFound: We could not find this device in your account.
setup.errorNotConfigured: The server is not ready to configure devices. Ask the administrator to set the device setup secret on the Cloud API.
setup.errorGeneric: We could not prepare the setup QR. Check your connection and try again.
setup.errorQr: The QR code could not be drawn. Copy the link below instead.
